verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a cloud AI generation API and workspace like Luma, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency choices, or region-specific endpoints. The only base URL documented is https://api.lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/v1, with no regional variants, and dedicated capacity is described only in terms of throughput and latency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
